//: Vite strips types and never type-checks, so without `tsc --noEmit` in the
build script (see package.json) TypeScript here would be decoration: the
build would go green over code the compiler rejects.
`strict` is on for `strictNullChecks`, which is what makes the nullable
halves of this API mean anything: `whoami()`'s user, and `getElementById`
returning null. It is NOT what makes the `readFile` union bite — narrowing
a discriminated union works without it — so do not remove it believing
the union is what you are keeping.
